interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The water lineage
interactives.text: The stelae record the channels in the order they were claimed. What is made under the moot is recorded the same way, and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The study's under-deck. Books read three times as fast over the water.

interactives.label: The lineage
interactives.text: The tenth stela is blank. The scribe says the tenth channel was never claimed; the hermit says it was claimed twice.

interactives.label: Silt
interactives.text: The delta's centre is open water. The walkways are the roads; step off one and you swim.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The ruling
interactives.text: The ruling under rebuke still stands. Nobody has moved to rebuke the rebuke.

interactives.label: Verification
interactives.text: Verification of the lineage lapsed in the year the tenth stone was cut blank.

interactives.label: The labyrinth
interactives.text: The flooded labyrinth was a granary before the water came, and the water was let in.

interactives.label: The Stelae Reliquary
interactives.text: The court's relic room, opened with a shell.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Mixing
interactives.text: A field station mixes what a bench mixes. Two ingredients a step apart is what a garden is for.

sections.name: The Lotus Hollow
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: A hollow under the banyan's roots where the lotus opens out of the sun.

sections.name: The Paddy Garden
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: A sunken paddy under the tower where flax and thistle grow a step apart.

sections.name: The Market Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The market's own cellar: a chest, a bench and the sap the dyers keep back.

sections.name: The Moot Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The moot's strongroom above the flood line.

sections.name: The Crab Pit
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: A mud pit under the overlook where the young learn what armour is.

sections.name: The Deck Study School
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: Where the stelae court's scribes learn the order of the channels.

sections.name: The Green Temple Spring
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A warm feed under the temple; the silt around it never sets.

sections.name: The East Watch Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the watch with herons at the far end that will not fly.

sections.name: The Stelae Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: The court's relic room, opened with a shell.

sections.name: The South Shrine Well
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The shrine's cistern swallows spells; the crabs penned there are indifferent.

sections.name: The Great Arch Focus
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: Under the great arch the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Bund-Run
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: A drain the bund wardens drove under the border, out onto the moor.

sections.name: The Delta Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Four stones by the labyrinth mouth. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Banyan Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket in the banyan's crown.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Manymouth Delta Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
